name: Normethadone
summary: Normethadone, also known as desmethylmethadone or phenyldimazone, is a synthetic opioid analgesic and antitussive agent.

pharmacology.en: Like methadone it acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor. It lacks the methyl group that methadone carries on its carbon chain, and is weaker.
pharmacology.zh: 與美沙酮一樣，它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑。它缺少美沙酮碳鏈上的那個甲基，作用也較弱。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与美沙酮一样，它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂。它缺少美沙酮碳链上的那个甲基，作用也较弱。

uses.en: It was used as a painkiller and to suppress coughing. It is little used today.
uses.zh: 它曾用作止痛與止咳藥物，現今已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾用作止痛与止咳药物，现今已很少使用。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It was sold in Germany in a cough syrup called Ticarda, paired with a drug to counter its effects on the gut.
fact.zh: 它曾在德國以止咳藥水 Ticarda 的形式販售，配方中搭配另一種藥物以抵銷它對腸道的作用。
fact.zhHans: 它曾在德国以止咳药水 Ticarda 的形式贩售，配方中搭配另一种药物以抵销它对肠道的作用。
